title: A feature's check stops the cycle with no test named
what: For a feature item the checker names one test from the change's new or changed tests as the item's test (q1_test), or the cycle picks one when the check is open 0 and the change adds tests; the cycle closes the item itself and stops only when the change adds no test at all.
why: Found by the front 30 Oct, twice in one hour: the cycle runs for the-change-cycle-script-lands-a-ready-change-its and one-digest-per-wave-instead-of-status-messages both ended 'stopped_at: check, the check closed with no test for the queue item (q1_test is empty)' although each check had open 0, a green gate and a new test file (tests/test_land_waits.py, tests/test_digest.py). The front closed each item by hand with `relay queue done --test`, one extra round per feature.
failing_case: A cycle run of a feature change whose check is open 0, gate green, and which adds tests/test_x.py ends with stopped_at check and q1_test empty.
pass_cases: A feature change with open 0 and an added test closes its item in the cycle
A change that adds no test still stops with a line naming the missing test
A fix item's q1_test behaviour is unchanged
